title: Dense Layer Forward and Backward
signature: def dense_forward_backward(x, W, b, dout) -> tuple
hints: Each gradient has the same shape as the thing it is a gradient of. Use shapes to decide where the transposes go.
For 2-D x: dx = dout @ W.T, dW = x.T @ dout, db = dout.sum(axis=0).
With extra leading dimensions, every leading position is just another row. Reshape x to (-1, D) and dout to (-1, M), then reshape dx back.
